BrochureContent.Content:
Positioned in one of Belmullet's most sought-after coastal settings, this exceptional detached residence on Shore Road enjoys an unrivalled elevated position with breathtaking panoramic views across the bay, the surrounding countryside, the Atlantic Ocean and the islands beyond. Offering the perfect balance of peaceful coastal living and convenience, the property is just a short walking distance from Belmullet town and all local amenities.

This substantial family home is presented in immaculate condition and offers generous, well-proportioned accommodation comprising an inviting entrance hall, spacious living room, kitchen, dining room, utility room, parlour and four/five bedrooms, providing flexibility for modern family living.

Adjoining the main residence is a dedicated office and a self-contained annex, ideal for remote working, extended family or guest accommodation. Externally, the property is surrounded by beautifully maintained lawned gardens and benefits from a large detached double garage with excellent potential for conversion, subject to the necessary planning permissions.

The home has been extensively upgraded in recent years, including a stylish new kitchen, replacement windows, a modern heating system and high-quality décor throughout, allowing the new owners to move in and immediately enjoy all that this outstanding property has to offer.

Set on a generous site with substantial landscaped lawns and paved patio with incredible sea views. Part of the grounds offers the potential to be separated for an individual residential site, subject to the appropriate planning consent, providing an attractive future development opportunity.

Rarely does a property of this calibre come to the market, combining exceptional accommodation, outstanding presentation and truly spectacular coastal views. This is a unique opportunity to acquire a landmark home in one of North Mayo's most desirable locations.
